newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman sees 3,200 esc EDP target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman sees 3,200 esc EDP target.

text.p: Goldman Sachs, which announced on Tuesday it was beginning coverage of newly-privatised EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, sees the utility trading at around 3,200 escudos over the next few months, an analyst at the investment bank told Reuters.
The stock was trading at 3,259 escudos on Tuesday, down 11 escudos on Monday's close. Goldmans said earlier that it rated the stock as a market performer.
The analyst, who asked not to be named, said that the price of EDP was being supported essentially by domestic investors because foreign investors did not regard the stock as cheap.
Goldman is forecasting net profits for EDP of 89 billion escudos in 1997, up from 81 billion last year.
The analysts said that EDP was trading at a 17 to 20 percent premium to Spain's, while of a price to cashflow basis, the premium was close to 17 percent.
